title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
prompt: You are given the heads of two sorted linked lists list1 and list2. Merge the two lists into one sorted list. The list should be made by splicing together the nodes of the first two lists. Return the head of the merged linked list.
hints: Use a dummy node to simplify handling the head. Create a tail pointer that moves as you merge.
Compare the values of the current nodes. Append the smaller one to the result and move that list forward.
When one list is exhausted, append the rest of the other list to the result.
O(n + m) time, O(1) space (reuse nodes).
